profile.grammar: Complete single JSON number token, no whitespace or BOM; input is Rust str, not a byte/UTF8 decoder
profile.mathematical_rule: Original normalized decimal equals vetted shortest JCS decimal after finite binary64 conversion; reject unsupported precision/underflow; signed zero canonical0
profile.exponent_classification: Strip exponent leading zeros; after complete grammar lexical zero ignores any exponent magnitude. Nonzero exponent beyond8192 cannot be compensated within4096input bytes, so cannot be supported. This is a derived rejection shortcut, not another accepted-token cap.
profile.allocation: Selected finite primitive to_vec subset requests a 128byte Vec and one boxed mutable-writer reference; 132byte ryu stack buffer. Empty object/key/value collections allocate no nodes. Conservative scalar payload/scratch proof and actual native boundaries precede accepted use; this is not complete-source memory/RSS/work qualification.
